status: FR-007 recipe proposal — pending review; not implemented

terminalPoolOverrides.reason: Explicit user selection: Dwarf Sniper + Musketeer IV + Grenadier IV.

successorPolicy.scope: Distinct immediate output recipes for an exact family and rank, including shared Secret recipes.

branchPolicies.name: Dwarf Berserkers
branchPolicies.reason: Existing Shieldguard-led lineage. Boar Rider is retained; the selected Axeman and Berserker replacements establish Blacksmith as the second support.

branchPolicies.name: Muskets and snipers
branchPolicies.reason: The user explicitly restricts ordinary recipes to Musketeer, Griffin Handler and Grenadier.

branchPolicies.name: Boar riders
branchPolicies.reason: The user explicitly restricts ordinary recipes to Boar Rider, Shieldguard and Dwarf Miner.

branchPolicies.name: Bombs and siege
branchPolicies.reason: Proposed three-family pool: existing Grenadier and Blacksmith entry/progression plus Griffin Handler from the Griffin Bomber path. The former Runesmith entry and Dwarf Miner TOP support are replaced.

branchPolicies.name: Iron golems and crank Gatlings
branchPolicies.reason: The user explicitly restricts ordinary recipes to Dwarf Miner, Musketeer and Grenadier.

branchPolicies.name: Runic magic and immunity weakening
branchPolicies.reason: The user explicitly restricts ordinary recipes to Runesmith, Blacksmith and Dwarf Miner.

branchPolicies.name: Griffin riders
branchPolicies.reason: The user explicitly restricts ordinary recipes to Griffin Handler, Musketeer and Runesmith.

branchPolicies.name: Blacksmiths and flame machines
branchPolicies.reason: The user explicitly restricts ordinary recipes to Blacksmith, Dwarf Miner and Grenadier.

branchPolicies.name: Emerald Guardians
branchPolicies.reason: Retain Emerald Elf as the explicit main family. Ranger and Stormspear support the current Physical frontline and preserve its later Stormspear ingredients with one ordinary-family replacement.

branchPolicies.name: Moonlight Rangers
branchPolicies.reason: The existing ordinary recipe ingredients already fit Ranger, Priestess and Stormspear; only the Basic main rank needs reducing.

branchPolicies.name: Thunder Phoenixes
branchPolicies.reason: Priestess and Lunar Spirit Shaman preserve the current later magical and immunity-support ingredients; replacing the entry Dragon Keeper makes one coherent three-family normal pool.

branchPolicies.name: Drow Phantoms
branchPolicies.reason: Moonblade Assassin and Nightweaver Spider retain the existing lunar entry recipe and most later ingredients. Priestess becomes an external terminal-specialist ingredient instead of an ordinary-branch ingredient.

branchPolicies.name: Nightweaver Brood
branchPolicies.reason: Lunar Spirit Shaman and Moonblade Assassin preserve every ordinary native family already used by this lunar branch.

branchPolicies.name: Shadow Assassins
branchPolicies.reason: Emerald Elf and Nightweaver Spider preserve the current entry and most later Physical and healing-denial ingredients; the normal Advanced Shaman is replaced by Emerald Elf.

branchPolicies.name: Elven Battlemages
branchPolicies.reason: Stormspear and Emerald Elf preserve the current entry, Advanced and TOP family set; the Intermediate Ranger becomes Emerald Elf.

branchPolicies.name: Fire dragons
branchPolicies.reason: Stormspear and Elven Priestess preserve the current dragon entry and TOP support families. Repeated Dragon Keeper ingredients at different ranks remain valid distinct instances.
